name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
category:
Agriculture & Direct Income Support | Small, marginal, and landholding farmers



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Provides guaranteed direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families, transferred directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).



- **Eligibility:** Landholder farmer families with cultivable land parcels registered in their name. Institutional landholders, active/retired government employees, and income-tax payers are excluded.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, landholding ownership records (Khata/Khasra/RoR), bank passbook details, and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the official portal and locate the **Farmers Corner** on the homepage.



  2. Click **New Farmer Registration** and select either Rural or Urban Farmer Registration.



  3. Enter your Aadhaar number and active mobile number, then select your state to request an OTP.



  4. Fill in land ownership details, survey/khasra numbers, and bank account credentials.



  5. Submit the form and verify identity using Aadhaar-based eKYC. (Alternatively, apply offline through any local Common Service Centre - CSC).



- **Official Link:** [pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in/)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
category:
Agricultural Risk Protection | All farmers growing notified crops



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Low-cost comprehensive crop insurance covering non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, post-harvest losses). Farmers pay nominal flat premiums (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops), with the remaining subsidy shared by Central and State Governments.



- **Eligibility:** All farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, cultivating notified crops in notified areas.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or tenancy agreement, sowing certificate issued by local revenue/agriculture officer, and bank passbook.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the PMFBY portal and select **Farmer Corner** -> **Guest Farmer** (or log in).



  2. Fill in personal profile details and Aadhaar identity verification.



  3. Select crop type, season, year, state, district, and survey/plot number.



  4. Upload scanned copies of the land record and sowing certificate.



  5. Pay the subsidized farmer premium share online or register directly via your loan-providing bank or nearest CSC before the seasonal cut-off date.



- **Official Link:** [pmfby.gov.in](https://pmfby.gov.in/)

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
category:
Concessional Agricultural Credit | Farmers, animal husbandry, dairy, and fisheries workers



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Provides institutional short-term credit up to ₹3,000,000 at a concessional base interest rate of 7%, dropping to an effective 4% per annum upon prompt repayment. Collateral-free loans are available up to ₹160,000.



- **Eligibility:** Individual/joint borrowers, owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture or allied sectors aged 18 to 75.



- **Documents Required:** Identity and address proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID), land ownership documents or registered tenancy deed, crop pattern certificate, and passport-size photographs.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the national credit portal **JanSamarth** or your local public/cooperative bank branch.



  2. Download the simplified one-page KCC application form.



  3. Fill in applicant details, operational landholding size, and expected cropping pattern.



  4. Submit the form alongside land revenue extracts to the rural bank branch.



  5. The bank inspects the land record and issues an activated KCC debit card within 14 business days.



- **Official Link:** [jansamarth.in](https://www.jansamarth.in/)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
category:
Social Security & Pension | Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs)



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Voluntary, contributory old-age pension scheme providing an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching age 60. The Central Government provides an exact 50% matching monthly contribution (ranging from ₹55 to ₹200 based on entry age).



- **Eligibility:** Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares (5 acres) of cultivable land, aged between 18 and 40 years. Must not be covered under EPFO, ESIC, or NPS.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, Savings Bank Account passbook or Jan Dhan account details.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or visit the Maan-dhan portal.



  2. Provide your Aadhaar number and bank details for automated monthly debit authorization.



  3. Pay the first monthly subscription amount in cash at the CSC.



  4. Sign the auto-debit mandate form generated by the system.



  5. Collect your unique **Kisan Pension Card** with the assigned Pension Account Number.



- **Official Link:** [maandhan.in](https://maandhan.in/)

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
category:
Rural Livelihood & Guaranteed Wages | Rural low-wage and manual laborers



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Provides a legal guarantee of at least 100 days of unskilled wage employment per financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for manual work. Wages are set by individual states and paid directly into bank/post office accounts via DBT.



- **Eligibility:** Any adult resident of a rural household willing to undertake unskilled manual labor.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, proof of rural residence, photograph of adult household members, and bank/post office passbook.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Submit a written or oral application to the local Gram Panchayat office.



  2. The Gram Panchayat verifies residence and issues an official **MGNREGA Job Card** within 15 days of application at zero cost.



  3. Submit a written demand for work specifying preferred timing and duration.



  4. The Panchayat issues a dated receipt and assigns work within 5 km of the village within 15 days (or provides an unemployment allowance).



- **Official Link:** [nrega.nic.in](https://nrega.nic.in/)

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) & e-Shram
category:
Pension & Social Security | Unorganized daily-wage workers



- **Description & Key Benefits:** A national social security initiative that registers unorganized workers via an **e-Shram UAN Card** and provides an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60 under PM-SYM. Features 50:50 equal monthly co-contribution from the Central Government.



- **Eligibility:** Home-based workers, street vendors, head-loaders, agricultural laborers, construction workers, and domestic helpers aged 18–40 years earning ₹15,000 or less monthly. Must not be income-tax payers or enrolled in EPFO/ESIC.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, active Aadhaar-linked mobile number, and Savings/Jan Dhan bank account details.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the e-Shram portal to create an unorganized worker identity profile and download the 12-digit UAN Card.



  2. Navigate to the Maan-dhan portal (or visit any CSC) for PM-SYM enrollment.



  3. Authenticate with Aadhaar and mobile OTP.



  4. Set up auto-debit consent with your savings bank account.



  5. Download the completed **Shram Yogi Pension Card**.



- **Official Link:** [eshram.gov.in](https://eshram.gov.in/) & [maandhan.in](https://maandhan.in/)

name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
category:
Micro-Enterprise & Working Capital | Urban and peri-urban street vendors



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Collateral-free working capital micro-loans designed to pull informal vendors into the formal financial fold. Offers tiered loan tranches: ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche). Offers a 7% annual interest subsidy on early repayment and up to ₹1,200 annual digital cashback.



- **Eligibility:** Street vendors and roadside hawkers possessing a Certificate of Vending (CoV), identity card, or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB).



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, Certificate of Vending/ULB Recommendation letter, and bank passbook.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Visit the official PM SVANidhi portal and click **Apply for Loan**.



  2. Log in using your mobile number linked to your Aadhaar.



  3. Select your vendor category and enter your ULB Survey Reference Number (SRN) or Letter of Recommendation.



  4. Select a nearby lending institution (Bank, NBFC, or MFI).



  5. Submit the application; the institution verifies your documents and disburses funds directly to your account.



- **Official Link:** [pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/)

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
category:
Healthcare Social Safety Net | Bottom 40% vulnerable and low-income families



- **Description & Key Benefits:** The world's largest government-funded health assurance initiative, providing cashless, paperless medical treatment cover of up to ₹500,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals.



- **Eligibility:** Rural and urban families identified under deprivation categories based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) criteria, as well as state-expanded low-income target rosters.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, Ration Card (or official family membership documentation), active mobile number.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Go to the official Beneficiary NHA portal and log in under the **Beneficiary** option using your mobile number and OTP.



  2. Search for your family’s eligibility using your Ration Card Number, Aadhaar Number, or Family ID.



  3. Select your name and complete online biometric/OTP-based eKYC.



  4. Upload a recent photograph.



  5. Once approved by local authorities, download the verified **Ayushman Card** directly to your device.



- **Official Link:** [beneficiary.nha.gov.in](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/\&authuser=1)

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) & PMJJBY
category:
Micro-Insurance | Low-wage earners and unorganized workers



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Low-cost social security micro-insurance. PMSBY provides accidental death and full disability coverage of ₹200,000 (₹100,000 for partial disability) for an annual premium of ₹20. Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) provides ₹200,000 life insurance coverage for death due to any reason at ₹436 annually.



- **Eligibility:** PMSBY: Account holders aged 18 to 70 years. PMJJBY: Account holders aged 18 to 50 years.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card and an active savings bank or Jan Dhan account.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Log into your bank's mobile banking app or Internet banking portal, or visit your branch in person.



  2. Locate the **Government Social Security / JanSuraksha** tab.



  3. Select PMSBY, PMJJBY, or both.



  4. Select the savings account for auto-debit of the nominal annual premium and designate a nominee.



  5. Submit the consent mandate; insurance coverage activates on the first day of the subsequent month.



- **Official Link:** [jansuraksha.in](https://jansuraksha.in/)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
category:
Rural Housing Infrastructure | Rural homeless and households in kutcha houses



- **Description & Key Benefits:** Direct financial subsidy of ₹120,000 in plain areas and ₹130,000 in hilly/difficult/North-Eastern states to construct a durable pucca house. Also provides 90–95 person-days of unskilled labor support under MGNREGA (\~₹25,000) and an additional ₹12,000 grant for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission Gramin.



- **Eligibility:** Rural families living in zero/one/two-room kutcha houses, selected via SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and the validated Awaas+ survey list. Household income ceiling is ₹15,000 per month.



- **Documents Required:** Aadhaar Card, bank passbook, MGNREGA Job Card number, and land availability documentation.



- **Steps to Apply:**



  1. Identification and prioritization are conducted by the Gram Sabha via the local Panchayat based on the Awaas+ list.



  2. The Gram Panchayat or Block Development Officer (BDO) registers the identified beneficiary on the **AwaasSoft** portal.



  3. Officers capture and upload geo-tagged photographs of the existing dilapidated dwelling.



  4. Bank account and Aadhaar details are validated through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS).



  5. Financial assistance is released directly into the beneficiary’s account across distinct phases of construction.



- **Official Link:** [pmayg.dord.gov.in](https://pmayg.dord.gov.in/)
